Area(s) of responsibility

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Scientist with strong expertise in Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and MLOps. The ideal candidate will be responsible for building scalable predictive models, driving advanced analytics, and operationalizing ML models in production environments. This role requires a deep understanding of statistical modeling, predictive analytics, and Python-based data ecosystems, with exposure to modern platforms such as Databricks Mosaic AI and Snowflake Cortex being an added advantage.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and deploy machine learning and AI models for real-world business problems.
• Perform advanced statistical analysis and build predictive models to derive actionable insights.
• Develop and implement end-to-end ML pipelines, including data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, validation, and deployment.
• Build and manage MLOps frameworks for continuous integration, delivery, monitoring, and model governance.
• Work closely with data engineering teams to ensure robust and scalable data pipelines.
• Conduct exploratory data analysis (EDA) and hypothesis testing to support data-driven decision-making.

Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Security Consultant, you specialize in implementing security solutions for clients and stakeholders while addressing security, regulatory, risk, and compliance issues. You maintain a current understanding of industry trends and hold multiple certifications in key cyber security areas.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

• Implement Security Solutions: Deliver security initiatives and projects that address client needs and ensure the achievement of business objectives. This involves collaborating with stakeholders to identify and mitigate risks.
• Develop Mitigation Plans: Identify potential security risks and create effective mitigation plans to minimize their impact. This requires staying up-to-date with industry trends and leveraging expertise in key cyber security areas.
• Define Security Strategies: Develop business-driven security strategies and roadmaps that align with client goals and objectives. This involves communicating effectively with stakeholders to ensure successful implementation.
• Collaborate with Stakeholders: Work closely with clients and internal stakeholders to ensure the successful implementation of security initiatives and achievement of business objectives.
• Maintain Industry Knowledge: Stay current with industry trends and maintain multiple certifications in key cyber security areas to provide expert guidance and advice.

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

• Exposure to Security Solution Implementation: Experience working with security initiatives and projects that address client needs and ensure the achievement of business objectives.
• Understanding of Risk Mitigation: Exposure to identifying potential security risks and creating effective mitigation plans to minimize their impact.
• Familiarity with Security Strategy Development: Experience working with business-driven security strategies and roadmaps that align with client goals and objectives.
• Knowledge of Industry Trends: Exposure to staying current with industry trends and maintaining multiple certifications in key cyber security areas.
• Collaboration with Stakeholders: Experience working closely with clients and internal stakeholders to ensure the successful implementation of security initiatives and achievement of business objectives.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

• Multiple Cyber Security Certifications: Holding certifications in key cyber security areas, such as security solution implementation, risk mitigation, and security strategy development.
• Industry Trend Awareness: Maintaining a current understanding of industry trends to provide expert guidance and advice on security initiatives and projects.
